mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`ai_conversation`(id, user_id, title, model, message_count, last_message_preview, is_pinned, is_archived, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{model}, #{messageCount}, #{lastMessagePreview}, #{isPinned}, #{isArchived}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from booknest.`ai_conversation` where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 order by update_time desc
mapper.update: update booknest.`ai_conversation` set status = 0 where id = #{id}
